description: As a proud New Mexican, I am committed to addressing the critical issues facing our communities. My mission is to fight for our families and the issues that matter most, such as tackling the lasting effects of the 2020 pandemic, voter integrity, looming food and energy crisis, and the continued push for Environmental Social Governance (ESG) that threatens the sovereignty of all industries, organizations, Local Government entities and our individual sovereignty. - Paul Spencer for District 6
